description: Prune block-1 pre-feed-forward LayerNorm biases in nearest-neutral order
proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 26 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters/99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0117, whose block-1 pre-attention bias coordinate 13 scored 98.58% at 1,671 parameters. Block 1 pre-FF previously tolerated individual bias pruning, and its current nearest eligible coordinate is bias 6 at -0.0638468. Hypothesis: that downstream pre-FF centering site remains more redundant than either now-bounded pre-attention site. The helper orders its 14 eligible biases by current magnitude, fixes one per micro-trial, and uses only official runner acceptance/rollback. Stop on first scored discard or error, no candidate, 14 micro-trials, or 20 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than revisiting a failed pre-attention coordinate because it changes site while following positive historical evidence.
summary: The block-1 pre-FF bias policy evaluated its least-magnitude eligible coordinate, index 6 at -0.0638468. The 1,671-parameter candidate scored 95.22% and was discarded. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors; frontier stayed 1,672/99.01%. Compute used one migration and one official verification in about 1m22s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 14-trial/20-minute cap.
